text: Binary per-row measure from OP context (title, argument) and OC_comments (JSON list of other users' comments, not the OP): returns 1 if at least one single comment both explicitly quotes/verbatim reproduces a specific phrase from the OP's title or argument (quotation marks or blockquote, must match available OP text) and argues against or refutes that same quoted phrase within that same comment. Endorsing-only quotes, paraphrases without quoted wording, and quote and refutation split across separate comments do not qualify. Returns 0 if the comment list is valid and none qualify, including an empty list; returns null if OC_comments, title or argument is missing or malformed so it can't be determined (a positive match found in available text may still give 1). Ignores as evidence OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and text reporting whether the outcome occurred (including within the argument); generic delta/platform-rule discussion remains eligible. Uses current supplied text, without inferring initial snapshots or comment order.
